QuestInfo.name: Lost Temple Keeper
QuestInfo.1: Who ever heard of a temple keeper getting lost in his own temple? Maybe you should tell the guy how to get back to the Three Doors.
QuestInfo.2: You told the temple keeper how to return to the Three Doors. Maybe he won't get lost this time...

0.0: May the goddess's blessings be with you. Welcome to the Temple of Time.\r\n#L0##bWho are you? And why are you here...?#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, that is... umm, well... If you have some time, could you help me?\r\n#L0##bHuh? I guess so. What do you need?#l\n#k
0.2: I'm a temple keeper here, but... I got lost... Could you tell me how to get to the Three Doors?\r\n#L0##b(This place is really easy to get around...) Just go left, you'll find the Three Doors.#l\n#k
0.3: Ah, I see. So keep going left...

no.0: It's just that... I forgot how to get back...

1.0: So all I really have to do is just keep going left?\r\n#L0##b(I'm not going to get out of taking him...) Yes. Take the portal on the left and you'll be in the Resting Spot of Memory. Once there, don't go down to the lower floor, but keep going left. You will eventually arrive at Memory Lane 1. Use the left portal in Memory Lane 1 and you will be at the Three Doors.#l\n#k
1.1: Oooh! You really are a kind person. Thank you very much! I'll do my best to find my way around!
